info.title: readmd — terminal Markdown viewer
info.description: A terminal-first, feature-rich Markdown viewer with live reload, search, [[_TOC_]], mermaid and D2 diagrams, and an optional browser mode.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: readmd — a terminal-first Markdown viewer with live reload, search, [[_TOC_]], mermaid and D2 diagrams, and an optional browser mode.

options.name: --browser
options.description: Open in the browser instead of the terminal (full-fidelity mermaid/D2/math). [default: False]

options.name: --port
options.description: Port for browser mode (0 = pick a free port). [default: 0]

options.name: --no-open
options.description: In browser mode, start the server but don't launch a browser. [default: False]

options.name: --best-effort
options.description: Terminal mode: skip the headless-browser download; mermaid diagrams open in the browser instead. [default: False]

options.name: --theme
options.description: Color theme: dark, light, auto, or a custom theme name from your config (default: auto).

options.name: --background
options.description: Background fill: 'solid' paints a solid themed background (overrides terminal transparency); 'terminal' lets the terminal background show through.

options.name: --d2-path
options.description: Explicit path to the d2 executable (defaults to 'd2' on PATH).

options.name: --export
options.description: Export to a self-contained file and exit. The format is chosen from the extension: .html (default) or .pdf.

options.name: --print
options.description: Render to stdout and exit (plain text, or ANSI when stdout is a terminal). Implied when stdout is redirected to a pipe or file. [default: False]

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to the Markdown file to view.

commands.name: completions
commands.description: Print a shell completion script to stdout.

arguments.name: SHELL
arguments.description: Shell to generate completions for: bash, zsh, pwsh, or fish.

commands.name: man
commands.description: Print a man page (troff) to stdout.

commands.name: install-pdf
commands.description: Download the headless browser used for high-quality PDF export (one-time, ~150 MB). Requires Node.js on PATH.
